title: ZEBRONICS Bro 3.5Mm Wired in Ear Earphones, in-Line Mic, Deep Bass, 1.2M Strong and Long Lasting Cable, Light Weight, Compatible with Mobile | Tablet | Laptop (Blue)
bullets: Immersive Soundscapes: The powerful ZEB-Bro has a 10mm driver, engineered to deliver impressive audio and deep bass.
Comfortable to wear: With the ZEB-Bro, you can enjoy extended listening sessions without the discomfort, its lightweight and ergonomic design make it the ideal companion for all-day use.
In-Ear design: Crafted with an ergonomic in-ear design, these earphones offer not only exceptional sound isolation but also unparalleled comfort.
Crystal-clear audio: The ZEB-Bro features an in-line mic for clear and precise voice capture, ideal for calls, voice commands, and online meetings.
3.5mm connector: The ZEB-Bro features a 3.5mm connector that works with compatible mobile, and tablets with a dedicated 3.5 mm jack.
1.2m Cable: Strike the perfect balance between freedom and practicality with the ZEB-Bro's 1.2m cable.
